title: Cellulose

why_it_matters.text: The most abundant organic polymer on earth: long chains of glucose that build every plant cell wall. Cotton is nearly pure cellulose.

sentences.text: Starch links its glucose units with alpha bonds, which human amylase can cut, so starch is food.
Cellulose links them with beta bonds, which flips every second unit over and produces a flat ribbon that human enzymes cannot touch, so cellulose is dietary fibre.
sentences.starts: Cellulose links them with beta bonds
